collect.title: Data we collect
collect.body: When you create an account, we store your username, email address, a hashed version of your password, your avatar if you upload one, and your game history. If you sign in with 42, we receive your 42 login and public profile information.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: Your data is only used to run the service: authenticate you, display your profile, match you with other players, and compute statistics and leaderboards. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

storage.title: Storage and security
storage.body: Data is stored in a database hosted by the project team. Passwords are never stored in plain text and all traffic is encrypted with HTTPS.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can view and edit your profile at any time. You can request a copy of your data or the deletion of your account by contacting us.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: This is a student project from 42 Le Havre. For any question about your data, contact the team through the project repository.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.body: By creating an account or using Pongo, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You are responsible for keeping your credentials secret and for all activity on your account. Your username must not impersonate someone else or be offensive.

conduct.title: Fair play
conduct.body: Cheating, exploiting bugs, harassing other players or disrupting the service is forbidden and may lead to suspension of your account.

service.title: Service availability
service.body: Pongo is a student project provided as is, without any guarantee of availability. Features may change or be removed at any time.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: These terms may be updated. The date at the top of this page shows the latest version.

editorial.name: Editorial
editorial.description: A sports magazine on paper: serif headlines, columns and a drop cap.
editorial.headline: The oldest video game is back, and it wants a rematch
editorial.lede: Fifty years after its first rally, Pong returns to the browser. Our reporters played hundreds of matches against friends, strangers and a suspiciously human AI. Here is what they found: the rules have not changed, but the stakes have. Every point counts on the leaderboard, every tournament has a winner, and every defeat comes with a rematch button.

terminal.name: Terminal

terminal.hint: Pick a command below to continue.

swiss.name: Swiss

swiss.headline: Pongo
swiss.tagline: One ball. Two players. Zero decoration.

riso.name: Riso zine
riso.description: Two-ink risograph print: pink and blue overprint, halftones, paper grain.
riso.headline: Pong is a sport
riso.tagline: Grab a paddle, call a friend, and make some noise in the cluster.

blueprint.name: Blueprint
blueprint.description: Technical drawing: grid paper, dimension lines and a title block.
blueprint.font: IBM Plex Sans Condensed + Plex Mono

Templates.motionDescription: The same Swiss landing page with different kinds of motion. The first three are 3D anime intros. Open one, hit Replay, pick a favorite.

gym.name: 3D · School gym
gym.description: Two school boys in a cel-shaded gym. The camera starts above the table like a game of Pong, tilts down into the action, then cuts between the players, dolly-zooms on the jump and orbits the smash in bullet time.

rooftop.name: 3D · Sunset rooftop
rooftop.description: A school rooftop at sunset with cherry petals in the air. A slow crane down, a low tracking shot, the hero jumping in silhouette against the sun and a full 360° orbit when time stops.

manga.name: 3D · Manga
manga.description: Black-and-white screentone shading in a club room. You see the rally through each player’s eyes, from the net and from above, then the camera rides the ball into the sky.

anime.name: 2D anime intro
anime.description: A loading screen, then a flat anime-style rally with an eye close-up and an impact frame. The final smash sends the red ball into the Swiss block logo.

kinetic.name: Kinetic
kinetic.description: Letters rise one by one, the red period drops in and bounces like a ball.

rally.name: Rally
rally.description: The abstract court plays by itself: a red ball with a motion trail and paddles that track it.

assemble.name: Assemble
assemble.description: A Swiss poster builds itself: the grid draws in, then blocks wipe into place.

attract.name: Attract mode
attract.description: A live AI vs AI match in the hero, like an arcade cabinet. Hover the court to play.

Templates.logosDescription: Five directions for the Pongo mark, each shown from poster size down to a 16 px favicon. Small sizes switch to the icon version.

ballO.name: Ball in the o
ballO.description: The red ball sits in the first “o”.

point.name: Full stop
point.description: The current mark: the name in black, closed by a red full stop.

paddle.name: Paddle P
paddle.description: The “P” is a paddle and a ball: a bar for the stem, the red circle for the bowl.

court.name: Court
court.description: A tiny court with two paddles and the ball, next to a lowercase name.

stack.name: Swiss block
stack.description: The name split on two lines in a solid square, with the ball on the grid.

characters.title: Character lab
characters.description: 3D prototypes of the two school boys in five model styles. Turn them, switch the pose and the screentone, then pick the one to animate in the manga intro.
characters.hint: Drag a model to turn it.

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: The models of the gym and rooftop intros, for comparison: rounder faces, simple hair.

sharp.name: Sharp manga
sharp.description: Taller manga proportions, V-shaped torso, pointed chin, slanted brows, many sharp hair spikes. Hexagonal limbs, diamond joints and angular shadows in the screentone. Used in the manga intro.

lowpoly.name: Low-poly
lowpoly.description: The sharp models with flat facets and no outlines, like an early 3D anime game.

chibi.name: Chibi
chibi.description: Big heads, tiny bodies, huge round eyes and round glasses. Cute rather than fierce.

ink.name: Ink silhouette
ink.description: Long-legged black silhouettes with white outlines and eye slits; only the red details stand out. Made for the screentone.
